t: 由乔治·弗里德里克·汉德尔(英语:George Frideric Handel)所创作的里纳尔…
te: Rinaldo by George Frideric Handel, the first Italian opera written for the London stage, is premièred.
dz: 由乔治·弗里德里克·汉德尔(英语:George Frideric Handel)所创作的里纳尔多是第一部为伦敦舞台所创作的意大利歌剧,是预作.
de: Rinaldo by George Frideric Handel, the first Italian opera written for the London stage, is premièred.

t: 奥斯曼与俄罗斯帝国签订的普鲁士条约已经签署.
te: The treaty of Pruth between the Ottoman and Russian Empire is signed.
dz: 奥斯曼与俄罗斯帝国签订的普鲁士条约已经签署.
de: The treaty of Pruth between the Ottoman and Russian Empire is signed.

te: Britain's Quebec Expedition loses eight ships and almost nine hundred soldiers, sailors and women to rocks at Pointe-au…
dz: 英国魁北克远征军在Pointe-aux-Anglais的岩石上损失了八艘船和近九百名士兵,水手和妇女.
de: Britain's Quebec Expedition loses eight ships and almost nine hundred soldiers, sailors and women to rocks at Pointe-aux-Anglais.

t: 图斯卡罗拉战争的首次出击始于今天的北卡罗来纳.
te: The first attacks of the Tuscarora War begin in present-day North Carolina.
dz: 图斯卡罗拉战争的首次出击始于今天的北卡罗来纳.
